** HEADING-SAMPLE: 16pt bold Iosevka Publish Extended

OPENING-SAMPLE: 12pt Iosevka Publish, with no first-line indentation
because this paragraph immediately follows its chapter heading.

BODY-SAMPLE: 12pt regular Iosevka Publish, with a 10mm first-line
indent. This longer paragraph demonstrates wrapped lines returning to
the body margin. Paragraph separation adds 3mm to the normal line
interval.

This paragraph contains *BOLD-SAMPLE*, /ITALIC-SAMPLE/, +STRIKE-SAMPLE+
and =INLINE-CODE-SAMPLE: 9pt Iosevka Publish=. A
[[https://example.invalid/manuscript/path][LINK-SAMPLE]] retains its
target. CÁIT and MAIRÉAD retain their accents.

#+begin_quote
QUOTE-SAMPLE: 10pt italic Iosevka Publish Extended. Every line begins
6mm from the body edge; quote clearance adds 4mm above and below.

QUOTE-SECOND-PARAGRAPH: the same 6mm inset, with no extra native quote
indentation.
#+end_quote

#+begin_src text
CODE-SAMPLE: 9pt Iosevka Publish.
All lines start 8mm from the body edge.
Clearance adds 5mm above and below.
#+end_src

=STANDALONE-CODE-SAMPLE: this complete-line code span becomes a block.=

- LIST-FIRST: an editable bullet.
  - LIST-NESTED: a nested editable bullet.
- LIST-LAST: the second top-level bullet.

1. ORDERED-FIRST: the first numbered item.
2. ORDERED-LAST: the second numbered item.

| TABLE-HEADER-LEFT | TABLE-HEADER-RIGHT |
|-------------------+--------------------|
| TABLE-CELL-LEFT   | TABLE-CELL-RIGHT   |

--------------

NOTE-ANCHOR: this sentence links to an editable native footnote.[fn:1]

# PRIVATE-SENTINEL must never appear in an export.

FINAL-SENTINEL: this final paragraph proves that the document was not
truncated.
